subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: What recovery contract should own a compaction timeout after user-visible output may already have been produced or delivered?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses session liveness, compaction progress reuse, and outbound logical-send idempotency, and automation should not choose the durable contract while related PRs and protected labels are still active.

options.title: Single cross-boundary recovery contract
options.body: Define the paused/terminal state and logical-send idempotency requirements together, then land narrow fixes against that contract.

options.title: Split by active trackers
options.body: Let #92043 own compaction progress, #96242 own Telegram duplicate delivery, and close this only after both paths have live proof.

options.title: Accept current partial mitigations
options.body: Treat the current paused-state and ambiguous-send replay checks as sufficient and close after maintainer sign-off despite missing full live proof.

recommendation.title: Single cross-boundary recovery contract
recommendation.body: Define the paused/terminal state and logical-send idempotency requirements together, then land narrow fixes against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and has recent adjacent compaction-notice work, making them the best available routing owner from the inspected history.
